exactSpokenText:
This is Northvane, a roofing website concept by Wallace Shift. It helps homeowners understand the work and prepare for a useful first conversation.

The opening illustration walks through the roof replacement, showing how the work comes together.

The roof planner then turns choices into a budget. We are using its built-in sample house.

Adjust the pitch and choose metal. The roof area and planning range respond. These prices are illustrative.

Explore a payment scenario, with the monthly amount and total of payments visible together.

The project questions gather the roof concern, payment approach, and timing, before asking for contact details.

Those answers become a structured lead preview, alongside the estimate and payment already explored. Nothing is sent from this demonstration.

The distinctive feature is the connection: the homeowner’s choices travel with the conversation.

Sentence boundaries refined against measured source silence, then remapped through each measured retained clip and pitch-preserving tempo change; no spoken text removed.

alignmentReview.method: Unprompted offline faster-whisper base.en recognition of the full actual Higgsfield take plus an independently recognized crop. Exact script token matching follows recognition. Only the affected sample-scene interval is replaced; scene cuts use measured silence and captions use observed phrase word spans.

cropEvidence.review: Independent unprompted recognition of an original-audio 18.5–34.25 second crop contains one house and exactly matches sample and estimate text. Replace only the sample scene through 25.7s, inside its following silence. Full ASR duplicated house across a segment boundary; no token is simply discarded. The crop's later roof-area phrase has a zero-length internal word, so its estimate timestamps are not imported; that scene retains the valid full-take ASR timestamps.

alignmentReview.reviewedBy: Codex other_narrative_research agent, delegated source alignment review
findings: Full-take ASR recognized 135 words against the 134-word script: an extra house appeared across the 24.88s segment boundary.
The independent original-audio 18.5–34.25s crop recognizes house once and matches sample/estimate text exactly. Source 18.5–25.7s is replaced using that crop, ending within silence before Adjust.
The crop assigns zero duration to The in the later roof-area sentence. That interval is not imported; valid original full-take timings are retained for the estimate scene.
Final mapping contains all 134 script tokens, zero differences, zero invalid word spans, and no proper-name aliases. Northvane and Wallace Shift are recognized with their expected spelling.
All seven internal scene boundaries are within measured silent gaps; all 13 sentence/phrase spans are valid, ordered, and inside their scene ranges.
limitations: ASR agreement does not establish correct pronunciation, natural delivery, brand fit, synchronization, music balance, or buyer comprehension.
A crop-initial word may include leading silence. These are sentence captions, not word highlighting.
No subjective listening review has been performed. Final encoded playback and human buyer validation remain separate.
alignmentReview.pacingReview: Transformation follows user feedback; subjective listening is not claimed. Independent paced-audio ASR and final playback review remain separate checks.

processing: Existing Higgsfield take, pitch-preserving atempo=1.08. Sentence-adjacent silence trimmed with 0.14s handles; original scene WAVs, imported timing and source hashes retained. No speech generation. Natural within-sentence pauses are preserved.
